content: Standard 2025/2026 GitHub Actions pattern for a Java/Maven multi-module microservices repo: actions/setup-java@v4 with Java 21+temurin distribution, Maven dependency caching, a matrix or path-filtered job per service (build/test on push and PR), mvn verify running unit + Testcontainers-based integration tests, then a docker build/push step per service. ubuntu-latest runners ship Docker preinstalled, which Testcontainers relies on.
